judge.voice: Minecraft, jo! Sam was fun and his questions were tiny, so I could answer. When I wrote Dům, it told me "house", and then I said house — that was good, I felt clever. But the phrase buttons were annoying: I pressed the tree one three times and nothing happened, I just got "now use it yourself". Nevím why. At the end it said "dog is plural" — I don't know what plural is, that's school-talk. I'd use it again for the Minecraft part, and Mum would like that it saves club time. I'd tell a friend, but the long topic list with bookings and group projects looks like homework.
